notes.title: Achievements updated, and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Aviators![/h1]

We hope all of you are safe and well. 

Since our full release, we got a lot of feedback and responses from you, the players. Our team has worked hard to fix the bugs that were still present in the game.

[h2][b]A new update is now live![/b][/h2]

[h3]Changelist[/h3]
The highlight of the update is that achievements unlock properly when their conditions are met. Unfortunately, the fix required some changes in the way that progress was being tracked. This means that a new save is required for them to unlock correctly.

Broken achievements weren't the only thing that was worked on, the following changes have been made:
[list]
[*] Achievements unlock properly when conditions are met.
[*] Fixed Targets from disappearing on re-entering the game.
[*] Small tweaks and improvements to the UI.
[*] Removal of left-over debug functions.
[*] Floating foliage is removed or replaced.
[/list]

We would like to thank all of you who helped us by reporting bugs and filling in the form to provide us with extra data. We really appreciate your help and attention! <3

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
This update also marks the end of SKYE as a university project and with it the end of our team. With more time and resources we could have made SKYE even better, but everyone is off to a new adventure now.
Hopefully, you will see some of our names popping up in future games you love!

Thank you for helping us make SKYE a great experience!

Stay awesome!

The dev team.

notes.title: About Achievements...
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello aviators![/h1]

After launching yesterday, we've been monitoring achievements and the rates at which they have been unlocking and since before that we've been running internal tests to see if they were functioning correctly. Unfortunately that is currently not the case.

We are currently hard at work on finding the source of the issue so we can fix it. We want to see achievements popping up again, not bugs. We didn't want to leave you without a status update and some more information on the issues we're seeing though.

[h2]Which ones are the issue[/h2]
Data has been somewhat inconsistent regarding them, and we are happy to see that some people seem to be having no issues unlocking any achievement. However, the people that are having issues seem to be having most issues with the following two achievements:
[list]
[*] [b]That's right. I am dangerous.[/b] - [i]Listened to Elizabeth's war stories for the first time.[/i]
[*] [b]He's all over the place![/b] - [i]Found all the random spyglasses people lost over the years.[/i]
[/list]
As a result of these two causing issues we're indirectly seeing problems with another achievement as well, although this one doesn't seem to be inconsistent or having issues directly:
[list]
[*] [b]I'm getting off this plane![/b] - [i]Completed all other achievements in the game! You can retire now.[/i]
[/list]
We'd also like to mention a potential cause already:
Some reports indicate that losing your connection stops achievements from unlocking, even if you reconnect afterwards. Please keep in mind that this is unconfirmed though, we're investigating if connectivity issues are related.

[h2]Help us out![/h2]
[b]To help us out in gathering data we've opened up a short [url=https://forms.gle/8UidCLebsmdDVzkBA]achievement bug report form[/url]. If you're encountering problems we'd like to hear it from you.[/b]

Thanks for your time and we'll hope to see you soon!

The dev team.

notes.title: SKYE full release, out now!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello aviators![/b]


Last week we launched as an Early Access title. Since then we have received a lot of encouraging comments and useful feedback. We want to thank everyone who has helped us and took the time to share their thoughts. Your engagement was a huge motivational factor when working on this release.

The past few days our team has been hard at work, polishing the game and working out bugs. We focused on making the world feel more alive and engaging. We also read your feedback and tried to incorporate as much of it as we could!


[h1]What has improved?[/h1]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Saving: The game now stores your progress and settings.
[*] Achievements: There are now unlockable achievements in the game!
[*] Race resets: If a run isn’t going according to plan you can reset it midway through.
[/list]
[h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] Landscape: Large sections of the environment have been improved to look better and provide more engaging challenges.
[*] Life: Animals and plants have been improved to make the world feel more alive.
[*] Clouds: Moving across the sky, there are clouds you can fly through now.
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Music: We’ve added two new music tracks on top of the existing track.
[*] Audio: We’ve added gun sounds.
[/list]
[h2]Photo Mode*[/h2]
As part of the Early Access we sneakily included a developer Photo-mode. After seeing the great pictures you all have been taking, we'd like to formally give you the controls.
[list]
[*] Pressing "P" in the game freezes the game and ejects the camera from the plane
[*] Pressing "O" shows the options within Photo Mode
[/list]
[i]*Because it's a developer tool Photo Mode might cause unexpected bugs and errors.[/i]



[h1]Bugged Achievements[/h1]
Some achievements are not unlocking when the proper requirements are met.
We are aware of this and are working on a hotfix. You could help out by filling out our [url=https://forms.gle/8UidCLebsmdDVzkBA]Achievement Bug Report[/url]



[h1]About this release[/h1]
Today marks the full release of SKYE. As a student project this sadly also means the end of an academic year and with it our team.

We started working on the concept for SKYE in September 2019 and started active development in February of this year. The response we have received on the game has been tremendously rewarding and humbling for our entire team. Thank you all!

In the next few days we’ll be celebrating the successful launch of SKYE with you: the community. We’ll hope to see you soon!

Cheers!

The Dev Team.

notes.title: SKYE Early Access is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=UushR58b9Vg;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Aviators!

A few weeks ago we showed SKYE to the public for the first time. Since then we have had some very engaging weeks with our team. From expanding the size of the game, and dealing with the issues that arise from remote working at home, to fine-tuning our art vision by changing the colors and lighting in the game.

Today, SKYE launched as an Early Access title! Our celebration is short, because even as you are reading this we are continuing to improve it little by little.

Our main focus now is to deliver a product that is more polished from start to end, one that would give you the experience that our team envisioned at the beginning of this project. We are quite happy with how the game turned out right now, even though we've had some delays happen to certain aspects of the project. Fear not though! We have some time ahead of us and we will be delivering an update next week. As part of that update we plan to enhance the player experience by working on the assets that populate the game world.

Thanks for tuning in, feel free to leave a comment if you have any feedback or suggestions, and we can take it all into consideration moving forward. [url=https://discord.gg/YbWqJ4W]You can also join our Discord server here[/url]!

Cheers!

Co-pilot Bassam & Captain Marvin.
Community Manager & Design Lead.
